description: Week 6 evaluation dataset for the AI Workspace Platform. 68 unique cases across normal (>=15), difficult (>=10), ambiguous (>=8), tool_use (>=10), rag (>=10), and adversarial (>=7) categories. RAG and tool_use cases assume the fixture workspace seeded by backend/scripts/seed_eval_workspace.py (documents from app/evaluation/data/fixture_documents/, and the 6 default skills). 10 cases are flagged for human-vs-LLM-judge comparison (flagged_for_human_review=true) — human_label is left null for a reviewer to fill in with the shape {"overall_score": 1-5, "notes": "..."} after reading that case's actual model output from a completed evaluation run. Field reference: test_id/category/user_input are always populated; expected_behavior/expected_tool/expected_source/expected_structured_output/approval_required/critical_failure_conditions are populated where applicable to that case and null/false/empty otherwise. actual_result/score/pass_fail are execution-result fields, deliberately NOT stored here — see app/evaluation/runner.py and models/evaluation.py for the execution-result side, kept logically separate from these test definitions.
